thread:
maya: okay team, selfie thread — show me your pets doing something ridiculous. winner gets a virtual cookie :cookie:
sam: starting with Opal, the wombat. she discovered the ceiling fan and now judges us from the couch. pic: https://i.imgur.com/placeholder1.jpg :rofl:
oliver: no way, wombat is majestic. here’s Pixel mid-air ear flop. honestly peak content. https://imgur.com/placeholder2.jpg :ear:
marie: tiny rebuttal — Sushi the betta practicing her sassy side-eye at 3pm every day. clip: https://files.redwood/mock/sushi-eye.gif :fish:
jas: not to be dramatic but my hedgehog learned to tunnel under blankets. 3 seconds later: cuddle tornado. https://photos.app/hedgie-tunnel.jpg :star_struck:
maya: these are all unbeatable. quick poll: react with :heart: for Opal, :laughing: for Pixel, :eyes: for Sushi, :sparkles: for hedgehog?
photo-bot: poll created (24h) — Opal (wombat) / Pixel (dog) / Sushi (fish) / Hedgehog (jas)
sam: also, bonus category: most likely to steal snacks. Opal 100% :point_up:
oliver: Pixel stole my sandwich once. she then sat on it proudly. evidence: https://imgur.com/placeholder3.jpg :sandwich:
marie: Sushi demands thematic playlists. currently: "lo-fi aquarium vibes" :notes:
jas: hedgehog thumbs-up: will accept virtual cookie if we win :cookie::pray:
maya: vote with reactions and drop one more pic/gif if you want. love seeing these midweek smiles :heart_eyes:
sam: uploading one more — Opal's official stern nap. https://i.imgur.com/placeholder4.jpg :zzz:
oliver: last one from me — Pixel's dramatic ceiling stare (makes similar face to our runtime logs sometimes) https://imgur.com/placeholder5.jpg :eyes:
photo-bot: poll closed — results: Opal 9, Pixel 6, Sushi 3, Hedgehog 4. Winner: Opal (wombat) :trophy:
maya: OPAL WINS. handing virtual cookie to @jas and honorary wombat channel emoji incoming :cookie::wombat:
jas: thank you!! will cherish forever. bedtime now, Opal approves the decision :zzz:
